project.name: Agentic AI System for Data Pipeline Incident Investigation
project.descriptor: A system coordinating specialized agents to analyze data-engineering pipeline incidents, identify root causes, and recommend corrective actions.

requirements.statement: The system must analyze error logs for common patterns to determine the root cause of pipeline incidents.
The system must coordinate specialized agents to analyze pipeline dependencies.
The system must analyze SQL queries to identify potential issues.
The system must analyze data-quality issues to identify potential root causes.
The system must recommend corrective actions for human approval.
The system must flag uncertain root causes and notify the user.
The system must provide simplified summaries for ops teams.
The system must connect to data sources for log and SQL analysis.
The system must reduce incident investigation time from 4 hours to 1 hour.
The system must ensure recommendations for major changes are reviewed before approval.
The system must log all investigation activities for audit purposes.
The system must have a successful pilot with low error rates before autonomous operation.
Every screen the ops team uses must complete its primary action in three clicks or fewer.
The system must support integration with existing ops tools for notifications.
The system must allow configuration of agent parameters by data engineers.
The system must handle concurrent investigations without performance degradation.
The system must provide detailed reports of investigation outcomes.
The system must support role-based access control for security.

stories.title: Basic Log Analysis and Recommendation
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want the system to analyze error logs for common patterns and recommend a corrective action, so that I can identify a likely root cause faster than manual log review.

stories.title: Audit Logging for Investigations
stories.narrative: As a compliance officer, I want every investigation activity logged, so that I have an auditable record of how each incident was analyzed.

stories.title: SQL Analysis for Root Cause Identification
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want the system to analyze SQL queries involved in a pipeline, so that query-level issues are surfaced as part of root cause analysis.

stories.title: Data-Quality Analysis for Root Cause Identification
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want the system to analyze data-quality signals, so that data-quality problems are considered as a potential root cause.

stories.title: Coordinate Specialized Agents for Dependency Analysis
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want specialized agents coordinated to analyze pipeline dependencies, so that upstream and downstream dependency issues are included in the investigation.

stories.title: Recommendation Engine with Human Approval
stories.narrative: As an ops team member, I want recommended corrective actions to require human approval before being applied, so that major changes are reviewed rather than applied automatically.

stories.title: Notification System for Uncertain Cases
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want to be notified when a root cause is uncertain, so that I can review the case manually instead of trusting a low-confidence result.

stories.title: User Interface for Ops Teams
stories.narrative: As an ops team member, I want a simplified summary of each incident in the UI, so that I can understand what happened without reading raw logs.

stories.title: Detailed Reporting of Investigation Outcomes
stories.narrative: As a data engineer, I want a detailed report of each investigation's outcome, so that I can review what the system found and why.

stories.title: Pilot Testing and Performance Optimization
stories.narrative: As a project manager, I want a successful pilot with low error rates measured before the system operates autonomously, so that I can be confident it is safe to rely on.

measures.statement: The system must reduce incident investigation time from 4 hours to 1 hour.

guardrails.statement: The system must ensure recommendations for major changes are reviewed before approval.
The system must have a successful pilot with low error rates before autonomous operation.
The system must support role-based access control for security.
